description: Three commands install the pi-openai-compat plugin either from npm or from the GitHub source, which registers arbitrary OpenAI-compatible endpoints as first-class pi providers.

steps.description: Line 1 installs the plugin from npm; lines 2-3 show the alternative git install from the GitHub repository.
The plugin enables pi to connect to Ollama and OpenWebUI simultaneously, so their models appear in pi's own /model picker.

title: Installing the pi OpenAI-Compatible Plugin
